reason: That free one-pager sounds fine and costs me nothing, so I might read it. But I already pay for a CRM, a scheduling app and a review tool, and I use maybe a third of each, the last thing I need is another invoice.
objection: I have heard AI before and what it really means is a robot fumbling my customers while I am elbow-deep in a furnace, and I am not convinced some stranger in Roscoe understands my jobs better than I do.
would_change_my_mind: If the free one-pager named a specific dollar figure I am actually losing, quotes going cold, calls sitting in the missed-call log, and it matched what I know is true, then $950 for one narrow fix with the balance held until it passes a written test might be worth a shot.
